summary: Preserved PR 609's structural layout-algebra validation and closed PR 628's reproduced TileType gap by recursively validating every LayoutAttr embedded in a logical_divide tile before static-size calculation or layout algebra. The exact malformed tile changed from an assertion abort (134) to a location-bearing diagnostic (1).

tests.what_was_measured: The exact candidate C++/TableGen sources rebuilt with pinned LLVM and the prepared GPU numerical smoke passed before reproduction.
Failing-before evidence: the review's exact malformed embedded layout aborted at IntTupleUtils.h:996 in intTupleFilterZero because guide.rank() did not equal val.rank().
The corrected C++/TableGen sources rebuilt with pinned LLVM; the rebuilt native library passed the prepared FlyDSL vector_add numerical smoke.
Passing-after regression: the former abort became a targeted diagnostic that the tile divisor layout shape and stride must have congruent tuple structure.
All structural-validation diagnostics, including the malformed LayoutAttr embedded in TileType and legal dynamic controls, matched expectations.

tests.command: Run every RUN line in tests/mlir/LayoutAlgebra/*.mlir with rebuilt fly-opt and /opt/amdpilot/llvm-project/mlir_install/bin/FileCheck
tests.what_was_measured: All 11 LayoutAlgebra test files passed; the ten FileCheck pipelines and the verify-diagnostics regression all exited zero.

gpu_evidence: Both native rebuilds passed FlyDSL vector_add 100x1000 (predicated border blocks) on one AMD Instinct MI355X, gfx950. Corrected-build details are in /job/native-build.json.
remaining_limitations: Static validation can check tuple congruence and other type-profile properties, including layouts nested in tiles. Dynamic SSA extents and dynamic BasisAttr leaves do not expose their runtime values here, so value-dependent divisibility, bounds, and invertibility remain runtime concerns unless runtime checks are introduced. The GPU smoke validates operation of the rebuilt native library on gfx950; the verifier correction itself is architecture-independent. No LLVM change was required.
